keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
First Half ends, Wolverhampton Wanderers 0, Charlton Athletic 0.

Goal! Wolverhampton Wanderers 1, Charlton Athletic 0. Adam Armstrong (Wolverhampton Wanderers) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Mateus Mané with a cross.
Goal! Wolverhampton Wanderers 2, Charlton Athletic 0. Rafiki Saïd (Wolverhampton Wanderers) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Mateus Mané.
Mateus Mané (Wolverhampton Wanderers) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Charlton Athletic. Oliver Skipp replaces Joe Rankin-Costello.
Substitution, Charlton Athletic. Ivan Mesík replaces Amari'i Bell.
Substitution, Charlton Athletic. Sonny Carey replaces Alan Mwamba.
Substitution, Wolverhampton Wanderers. Marshall Munetsi replaces Tommy Doyle.
Substitution, Wolverhampton Wanderers. Jordan James replaces Rafiki Saïd.
Substitution, Charlton Athletic. Karlan Grant replaces Tyreece Campbell.
Substitution, Charlton Athletic. Matty Godden replaces Charlie Kelman.
Delay in match (Wolverhampton Wanderers).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Wolverhampton Wanderers. Sean Neave replaces Fer López.
Substitution, Wolverhampton Wanderers. Bertrand Traoré replaces Adam Armstrong.
Oliver Skipp (Charlton Athletic) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Wolverhampton Wanderers 2, Charlton Athletic 1. Matty Godden (Charlton Athletic) left footed shot from a difficult angle on the left to the bottom right corner.
Conor Coventry (Charlton Athletic) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Wolverhampton Wanderers. Tawanda Chirewa replaces Mateus Mané.
Hugo Bueno (Wolverhampton Wanderers) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Second Half ends, Wolverhampton Wanderers 2, Charlton Athletic 1.
